plan.title: SRC-AWD-065 Give Feedback on Awarding Page

steps.note: Open Master QCS for the prepared closed RFQ, as required for prepared-state cases.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration before opening the prepared event.
Open the awarding page where the Give Feedback control is available.

args.goal: On the awarding page, click Give Feedback, choose a rating, enter QA as the feedback, send it, and stop when the thank-you message is visible.

steps.note: No catalog action directly performs the feedback form interaction, so execute the buyer-side feedback submission on screen.
Verify that submitting the rated QA feedback produces the expected thank-you message.

args.goal: Reopen Give Feedback on the awarding page, leave the feedback empty, attempt to send it, and stop when the validation message Please share your feedback is visible.

steps.note: Exercise the empty-feedback negative path on the same awarding page.
Verify that empty feedback is refused with the required message.
